We introduce SSVP-SLT (Self-Supervised Video Pretraining for Sign Language Translation), an implementation of this framework consisting of two or optionally three stages: pretraining a continuous sign language encoder via masked autoencoding (MAE;  on anonymized video, then optionally bridging the modality gap via CLIP-style video-text pretraining , and finally training an SLT system via supervised finetuning using extracted features from the pretrained model.
